title: Generate the ADR-0020 candidate audit bundle and run bounded automated gates
description:
Generate the candidate audit bundle and run bounded automated gates for re-freeze
evidence. Each gate must state what it observes and what it does not. Passing automated
gates is entry evidence for independent audit, not proof that no defect or mechanic remains.
acceptance_criteria:
- Candidate bundle is reproducible and identifies exact candidate inputs/artifacts.
- Every automated gate states its bounded denominator and fails rather than false-greens unrecognized required input.
- Known finding regressions and source-authority checks pass.
- Capabilities in force have current binding/execution/state evidence.
- No bundle field claims universal clause/mechanic/deterministic/discovery completeness.
- Passing authorizes independent audit, not re-freeze by itself.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
